hook.say: Kids restless after the turkey? These scavenger hunts are free, and here are five ways to use them. Stay for the last one.

scenes.title: Toddler find & color
scenes.say: One. Jumbo pictures for little ones. They spot the real thing, then color the square.

scenes.title: No-leaving-your-seat hunt
scenes.say: Two. A table hunt for older kids and grown-ups. Spot every detail without leaving your seat.

scenes.title: After-dinner walk
scenes.say: Three. Head outside after the meal and check off leaves, acorns and scarecrows on the way.

scenes.title: Camera roll challenge
scenes.say: Four. Pass the page around and race to find a matching photo on your phone.

scenes.title: Riddle clue trail
scenes.say: And five, my favorite. Hide eight riddle cards around the house, and each one leads to the next.

end.say: They're all free. Search Thanksgiving scavenger hunt printamoo dot com.
